name: ballerina/xlsx
description: Provides functionality to read and write Microsoft Excel files in the XLSX format with type-safe data binding.

typeDefs.name: CACHED
typeDefs.description: Use the last cached value (default)

typeDefs.name: TEXT
typeDefs.description: Return the formula text, such as "=SUM(A1:A10)"

typeDefs.name: FAIL_IF_EXISTS
typeDefs.description: Fail instead of overwriting existing content

typeDefs.name: REPLACE
typeDefs.description: Overwrite existing content in place

typeDefs.name: APPEND
typeDefs.description: Add new content, shifting existing content down to make room

typeDefs.name: METADATA
typeDefs.description: Log only the metadata: timestamp, location, and message

typeDefs.name: RAW
typeDefs.description: Log only the offending row data

typeDefs.name: RAW_AND_METADATA
typeDefs.description: Log both the row data and the metadata

typeDefs.name: OVERWRITE
typeDefs.description: Overwrite the log on the first error, then append the rest

typeDefs.name: ErrorDetails
typeDefs.description: Details attached to an XLSX error.

fields.name: sheetName
fields.description: Sheet where the error occurred

fields.name: tableName
fields.description: Table where the error occurred

fields.name: cellAddress
fields.description: Cell address where the error occurred

fields.name: rowNumber
fields.description: Row number where the error occurred

fields.name: columnNumber
fields.description: Column number where the error occurred

fields.name: fieldName
fields.description: Record field involved in the error

typeDefs.name: Error
typeDefs.description: The base type for all `xlsx` module errors.

typeDefs.name: ParseError
typeDefs.description: The workbook content is malformed or could not be read.

typeDefs.name: FileNotFoundError
typeDefs.description: The XLSX file path does not exist or could not be accessed.

typeDefs.name: SheetNotFoundError
typeDefs.description: No sheet matches the given name or index.

typeDefs.name: SheetExistsError
typeDefs.description: A sheet with the target name already exists.

typeDefs.name: TypeConversionError
typeDefs.description: A cell value could not be converted to the target type.

typeDefs.name: ConstraintValidationError
typeDefs.description: A parsed record failed a `@constraint` rule.

typeDefs.name: TableNotFoundError
typeDefs.description: No table matches the given name.

typeDefs.name: TableExistsError
typeDefs.description: A table with the target name already exists.

typeDefs.name: TableOverlapError
typeDefs.description: A table write would overlap with another table.

typeDefs.name: InvalidTableRangeError
typeDefs.description: A table range or insert position is invalid.

typeDefs.name: Sheet
typeDefs.description:
A worksheet in a workbook, with methods to read and write rows, columns, cells, and tables.
Obtained from a `Workbook` (for example `getSheet` or `createSheet`); not constructed directly.

functions.name: getName
functions.description: Get the name of the sheet.

return.description: The sheet name, or an error

functions.name: getUsedRange
functions.description: Get the used range of the sheet in A1 notation, such as "A1:D50".

return.description: The used range, or an error

functions.name: getUsedCellRange
functions.description: Get the used cell range as a structured record, or nil if the sheet is empty.

return.description: The used range as 0-based indices, nil if the sheet is empty, or an error

functions.name: getRowCount
functions.description: Get the number of rows with data.

return.description: The row count, or an error

functions.name: getColumnCount
functions.description: Get the number of columns with data.

return.description: The column count, or an error

functions.name: getRows
functions.description: Read all rows from the sheet as records, maps, or a string grid.

return.description: The rows, or an error

functions.name: getRow
functions.description: Read a single row by index as a record, map, or string array.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: 0-based index within the data window, so `getRow(0)` is the first data row

return.description: The row, or an error

functions.name: putRows
functions.description:
Write rows to the sheet (records, maps, or string arrays).

By default rows are appended below the existing data; `sheetWriteMode` selects another
disposition.

parameters.name: writeHeaders
parameters.description: Write a header row from field names or map keys (default: true; ignored for `string[][]`)

parameters.name: startRowIndex
parameters.description:
0-based target row. Omitted, uses the mode's natural point: the end of the data for
`APPEND`, row 0 otherwise.

parameters.name: sheetWriteMode
parameters.description: How to treat existing content at the target (default: `APPEND`)

return.description: An error if the write fails

functions.name: getColumn
functions.description: Get a column of values by header name or 0-based index.

parameters.name: t
parameters.description: Target cell type (`CellValue`, which includes `()` for blank cells)

return.description: The column values, or an error

functions.name: getCell
functions.description:
Read a single cell, bound to the target type.

The target type drives the binding: the default `CellValue` yields the cell's natural value,
while a `time:Civil` / `time:Date` / `time:TimeOfDay` or scalar target yields that type.

return.description: The cell value, `()` for a blank cell when the target allows it, or an error

functions.name: setRow
functions.description:
Write a single row at the given 0-based row index.

By default the row is overwritten; `sheetWriteMode` selects another disposition. For a record
or map, values align to columns by header name, using the header at `options.headerRowIndex`.

parameters.name: headerRowIndex
parameters.description:
0-based row holding the headers, used to align a record or map by name (default: 0).
Ignored for `string[]` data, which is written positionally.

parameters.name: sheetWriteMode
parameters.description: How to treat existing content at the target row (default: `REPLACE`)

return.description: An error if the write fails

functions.name: setColumn
functions.description:
Write a column of values by header name or 0-based index.

Values are written into successive rows below the header row.

return.description: An error if the write fails

functions.name: setCell
functions.description: Write a single cell by 0-based row and column index.

return.description: An error if the write fails

functions.name: setCellByAddress
functions.description: Write a single cell by A1-notation address.

parameters.name: cellAddress
parameters.description: Cell address in A1 notation, such as "A1" or "B12"

return.description: An error if the address is invalid or the write fails

functions.name: deleteRow
functions.description: Delete a row from the sheet; subsequent rows shift up by one.

return.description: An error if the delete fails

functions.name: rename
functions.description:
Rename the sheet.

The new name must follow Excel rules (at most 31 characters, none of `\ / ? * [ ] :`) and be
unique in the workbook.

return.description: An error if the name is invalid or already taken

functions.name: getTable
functions.description: Get a table on this sheet by name.

return.description: The table, or a `TableNotFoundError` if it does not exist

functions.name: getTables
functions.description: Get all tables on this sheet.

return.description: The tables (may be empty), or an error on failure

functions.name: createTable
functions.description:
Create a table over an existing range.

The range must include a header row. If `headers` is not given, the first row is used.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: Table range as a `CellRange` or A1-notation string

parameters.name: headers
parameters.description: Optional custom headers; if omitted, the first row is used

return.description: The created table, or an error

functions.name: createTableFromData
functions.description:
Write data and wrap it in a new table, computing the range automatically.

The table always has a header row: field names (or `@xlsx:Name`) for records, keys for maps,
or the first row for `string[][]`.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Data to write (records, maps, or string arrays)

return.description: The created table, or an error

functions.name: deleteTable
functions.description: Delete a table from this sheet. The underlying data is preserved.

return.description: A `TableNotFoundError` if the table does not exist, or another error

typeDefs.name: Table

functions.name: getName
functions.description: Get the name of the table. Table names are unique across the workbook.

return.description: The table name, or an error

functions.name: getDisplayName
functions.description: Get the display name of the table, as shown in the Excel UI.

return.description: The display name, or an error

functions.name: getSheetName
functions.description: Get the name of the sheet that holds this table.

return.description: The sheet name, or an error

functions.name: getRange
functions.description: Get the full table range, including the header and totals row, in A1 notation.

return.description: The range in A1 notation, such as "A1:D10", or an error

functions.name: getCellRange
functions.description: Get the full table range, including the header and totals row, as a `CellRange` (0-based).

return.description: The full table range, or an error

functions.name: getDataRange
functions.description: Get the data range, excluding the header and totals row, in A1 notation.

return.description: The data range in A1 notation, or an error

functions.name: getDataCellRange
functions.description: Get the data range, excluding the header and totals row, as a `CellRange` (0-based).

return.description: The data range, or an error

functions.name: getRowCount
functions.description: Get the number of data rows, excluding the header and totals row.

return.description: The data row count, or an error

functions.name: getColumnCount
functions.description: Get the number of columns in the table.

return.description: The column count, or an error

functions.name: getHeaders
functions.description: Get the column header names, in column order.

return.description: The header names, or an error

functions.name: getRows
functions.description:
Read all data rows from the table as records, maps, or a string grid.

The header and any totals row are excluded.

return.description: The data rows, or an error

functions.name: getRow
functions.description: Read a single data row by index as a record, map, or string array.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: 0-based index within the data range, so `getRow(0)` is the first data row

return.description: The row, or an error

functions.name: putRows
functions.description:
Write rows to the table, resizing its data range to fit.

By default the data is replaced; `tableWriteMode = APPEND` adds rows below it instead.
A resize that would overlap another table fails with a `TableOverlapError`.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Rows to write (records, maps, or string arrays)

parameters.name: tableWriteMode
parameters.description: How to treat the table's existing data (default: `REPLACE`)

parameters.name: insertAt
parameters.description:
For `APPEND`, the 0-based data-row index to insert at; omitted, appends at the end.
Ignored by `REPLACE`.

return.description: An error if the write fails

functions.name: hasTotalRow
functions.description: Check whether the table has a totals row.

return.description: Whether a totals row exists, or an error

functions.name: getTotalRow
functions.description:
Get the totals row as a map keyed by column name.

Each value binds to its natural cell value, or `()` for a blank total cell.

parameters.name: t
parameters.description: Result map type (default: `map<CellValue>`); a narrower type binds only if every cell fits

return.description: The totals by column name, or an error if there is no totals row

functions.name: rename
functions.description: Rename the table. The new name must be unique in the workbook.

return.description: An error if the rename fails, for example if the name is taken

functions.name: resize
functions.description:
Resize the table to a new range, which must include a header row and a data row.
For automatic resizing on write, use `putRows` instead.

parameters.name: newRange
parameters.description: New table range as a `CellRange` or an A1-notation string

return.description: An error if the range is invalid or overlaps another table

functions.name: deleteRow
functions.description:
Delete a data row by 0-based index; the table shrinks and rows below move up.

A table must keep at least one data row, so the last one cannot be deleted.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: 0-based index within the data range, so 0 is the first data row

return.description:
An error if the index is out of range, it is the last data row, or the shrink
would disrupt another table

typeDefs.name: FormulaMode
typeDefs.description: How to read cells that contain a formula.

members.name: TEXT
members.description: Return the formula text, such as "=SUM(A1:A10)"

typeDefs.name: SheetWriteMode
typeDefs.description: How a sheet write treats content already at the target.

members.name: APPEND
members.description: Add new content, shifting existing content down to make room

members.name: FAIL_IF_EXISTS
members.description: Fail instead of overwriting existing content

typeDefs.name: TableWriteMode
typeDefs.description:
How `writeTable` / `Table.putRows` treats the table's existing data.

`REPLACE` (default) replaces the data and resizes the range to fit; `APPEND` adds rows below it.
A table always has a data region, so there is no `FAIL_IF_EXISTS`.

members.name: APPEND
members.description: Add new content, shifting existing content down to make room

typeDefs.name: NameConfig
typeDefs.description:
Maps a record field to an Excel column header when the two names differ.
Applies on both read and write; fields without it use the field name as the header.

fields.name: value
fields.description: The Excel column header to map to this field

typeDefs.name: CommonParseOptions
typeDefs.description: Read options shared by every read operation; the common base of all read-option records.

fields.name: formulaMode
fields.description: How to read formula cells (default: CACHED)

fields.name: caseInsensitiveHeaders
fields.description: Match headers case-insensitively, so "Name" matches field `name` (default: false)

typeDefs.name: CommonSheetParseOptions
typeDefs.description: Read options for sheets, which address rows by absolute position.

fields.name: headerRowIndex
fields.description:
0-based row holding the column headers (default: 0). Set to `null` for no headers, which
names columns `col0`, `col1`, and so on. Ignored when reading into `string[][]`.

fields.name: dataStartRowIndex
fields.description: 0-based row where data begins (default: `headerRowIndex` + 1, or 0 when there are no headers)

typeDefs.name: DataProjection
typeDefs.description:
Data projection for record and map reads.

As `{}` (default) extra columns are ignored; as `false` every record field must have a column.

fields.name: nilAsOptionalField
fields.description: Treat nil cells as absent for optional fields (default: false)

fields.name: absentAsNilableType
fields.description: Allow missing columns for nilable fields (default: false)

typeDefs.name: ParseOptions
typeDefs.description: Options for bulk sheet reads (`parseSheet`, `Sheet.getRows`).

fields.name: rowCount
fields.description: Maximum number of data rows to read (default: all)

fields.name: enableConstraintValidation
fields.description: Validate parsed records against their `@constraint` annotations (default: true)

fields.name: allowDataProjection
fields.description: Data projection: `{}` ignores extra columns (default), `false` requires an exact match

fields.name: failSafe
fields.description: Skip and log row-level errors instead of failing the read

typeDefs.name: FailSafeOptions
typeDefs.description:
Fail-safe parsing: skip and log row-level errors instead of failing the read.
Structural errors (corrupted file, missing sheet, header errors) always fail immediately.

fields.name: enableConsoleLogs
fields.description: Log errors to the console (default: true)

fields.name: includeSourceDataInConsole
fields.description: Include the offending row data in console output (default: false)

fields.name: fileOutputMode
fields.description: Also write errors to a file

typeDefs.name: FileOutputMode
typeDefs.description: File-based error logging, written to when set in `FailSafeOptions`.

fields.name: filePath
fields.description: Path to the error log file (required)

fields.name: contentType
fields.description: What to include in each log entry (default: METADATA)

fields.name: fileWriteOption
fields.description: How to write the log file (default: APPEND)

typeDefs.name: ErrorLogContentType
typeDefs.description: What to include when logging parsing errors.

members.name: RAW_AND_METADATA
members.description: Log both the row data and the metadata

members.name: RAW
members.description: Log only the offending row data

members.name: METADATA
members.description: Log only the metadata: timestamp, location, and message

typeDefs.name: FileWriteOption
typeDefs.description: How to write the error log file (default: `APPEND`, which adds to the existing file).

members.name: OVERWRITE
members.description: Overwrite the log on the first error, then append the rest

members.name: APPEND
members.description: Add new content, shifting existing content down to make room

typeDefs.name: RowParseOptions
typeDefs.description: Options for reading a single sheet row (`Sheet.getRow`). Fail-fast: no `failSafe` or `rowCount`.

fields.name: enableConstraintValidation
fields.description: Validate the parsed record against its `@constraint` annotations (default: true)

fields.name: allowDataProjection
fields.description: Data projection: `{}` ignores extra columns (default), `false` requires an exact match

typeDefs.name: ColumnParseOptions
typeDefs.description: Options for reading a single column (`Sheet.getColumn`).

fields.name: rowCount
fields.description: Maximum number of cells to read (default: all)

typeDefs.name: TableParseOptions
typeDefs.description: Options for bulk table reads (`parseTable`, `Table.getRows`).

fields.name: rowCount
fields.description: Maximum number of data rows to read (default: all)

fields.name: enableConstraintValidation
fields.description: Validate parsed records against their `@constraint` annotations (default: true)

fields.name: allowDataProjection
fields.description: Data projection: `{}` ignores extra columns (default), `false` requires an exact match

fields.name: failSafe
fields.description: Skip and log row-level errors instead of failing the read

typeDefs.name: TableRowParseOptions
typeDefs.description: Options for reading a single table row (`Table.getRow`). Fail-fast: no `failSafe` or `rowCount`.

fields.name: enableConstraintValidation
fields.description: Validate the parsed record against its `@constraint` annotations (default: true)

fields.name: allowDataProjection
fields.description: Data projection: `{}` ignores extra columns (default), `false` requires an exact match

typeDefs.name: WriteOptions
typeDefs.description: Options for `Sheet.putRows`.

fields.name: writeHeaders
fields.description: Write a header row from field names or map keys (default: true; ignored for `string[][]`)

fields.name: startRowIndex
fields.description:
0-based target row. Omitted, uses the mode's natural point: the end of the data for
`APPEND`, row 0 otherwise.

fields.name: sheetWriteMode
fields.description: How to treat existing content at the target (default: `APPEND`)

typeDefs.name: SheetWriteOptions
typeDefs.description: Options for `writeSheet`.

fields.name: writeHeaders
fields.description: Write a header row from field names or map keys (default: true; ignored for `string[][]`)

fields.name: startRowIndex
fields.description:
0-based row where a fresh write starts (default: 0). Used by `FAIL_IF_EXISTS` and `REPLACE`;
ignored by `APPEND`, which writes below the existing data.

fields.name: sheetWriteMode
fields.description:
How to treat the sheet when it already exists (default: `FAIL_IF_EXISTS`). `REPLACE` drops
and recreates the sheet, discarding its tables and formatting.

typeDefs.name: RowWriteOptions
typeDefs.description: Options for writing a single row (`Sheet.setRow`).

fields.name: headerRowIndex
fields.description:
0-based row holding the headers, used to align a record or map by name (default: 0).
Ignored for `string[]` data, which is written positionally.

fields.name: sheetWriteMode
fields.description: How to treat existing content at the target row (default: `REPLACE`)

typeDefs.name: TableWriteOptions
typeDefs.description: Options for `writeTable` / `Table.putRows`.

fields.name: tableWriteMode
fields.description: How to treat the table's existing data (default: `REPLACE`)

fields.name: insertAt
fields.description:
For `APPEND`, the 0-based data-row index to insert at; omitted, appends at the end.
Ignored by `REPLACE`.

typeDefs.name: CellValue
typeDefs.description: An XLSX cell value: a string, number (int/float/decimal), boolean, date/time, or `()` for a blank cell.

typeDefs.name: Row
typeDefs.description:
A single row: either a `map<CellValue>` keyed by column header, or a `string[]` of cell text
in column order. A typed record also binds when every field type is a subtype of `CellValue`.

typeDefs.name: CellRange
typeDefs.description: A rectangular cell range in a sheet, with all indices 0-based.

fields.name: firstRowIndex
fields.description: First row index (0-based)

fields.name: lastRowIndex
fields.description: Last row index (0-based)

fields.name: firstColumnIndex
fields.description: First column index (0-based)

fields.name: lastColumnIndex
fields.description: Last column index (0-based)

typeDefs.name: Location
typeDefs.description: Location within an XLSX file where an error occurred.

fields.name: row
fields.description: Row number (1-based, as displayed in Excel)

fields.name: column
fields.description: Column number (1-based)

typeDefs.name: LogOutput
typeDefs.description: The structured JSON written to error log files.

fields.name: time
fields.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the error

fields.name: location
fields.description: Row and column where the error occurred

fields.name: message
fields.description: The error message

fields.name: offendingRow
fields.description: The offending row data (only with RAW_AND_METADATA)

typeDefs.name: Workbook
typeDefs.description:
Create an empty in-memory workbook. Persist it with `saveAs(path)`, since `save()` has no
source path yet. To open an existing workbook, use `xlsx:fromFile` or `xlsx:fromBytes`.

functions.name: init
functions.description:
Create an empty in-memory workbook. Persist it with `saveAs(path)`, since `save()` has no
source path yet. To open an existing workbook, use `xlsx:fromFile` or `xlsx:fromBytes`.

functions.name: getSheetNames
functions.description: Get all sheet names in the workbook.

return.description: Array of sheet names

functions.name: getSheetCount
functions.description: Get the number of sheets in the workbook.

return.description: Sheet count

functions.name: hasSheet
functions.description: Check whether a sheet with the given name exists.

return.description: Whether the sheet exists, or an error if the workbook is closed

functions.name: getSheet
functions.description: Get a sheet by name or 0-based index.

return.description: The sheet, or a `SheetNotFoundError` if it does not exist

functions.name: createSheet
functions.description: Create a new sheet in the workbook.

return.description: The new sheet, or a `SheetExistsError` if the name is taken

functions.name: deleteSheet
functions.description: Delete a sheet by name or 0-based index.

return.description: A `SheetNotFoundError` if the sheet is missing, or an error if it is the last sheet

functions.name: save
functions.description: Save the workbook, overwriting the file it was opened from or last saved to with `saveAs`.

return.description: An error if the workbook has no source path (created with `new`), or if the save fails

functions.name: saveAs
functions.description: Save the workbook to a new path, which then becomes the target of later `save()` calls.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to write the XLSX file to

return.description: An error if the save fails

functions.name: toBytes
functions.description: Serialize the workbook to a byte array, for example to send as an HTTP response.

return.description: The XLSX bytes, or an error if serialization fails

functions.name: close
functions.description: Close the workbook and release its resources. Call this when done to free memory.

return.description: An error if the close fails

functions.name: getTable
functions.description: Get a table by name from anywhere in the workbook. Table names are unique workbook-wide.

return.description: The table, or a `TableNotFoundError` if it does not exist

functions.name: getAllTables
functions.description: Get all tables across every sheet in the workbook.

return.description: All tables (may be empty), or an error on failure

functions.name: parseSheet
functions.description:
Parse a sheet from an XLSX file into records, maps, or a string grid.

```ballerina
Employee[] employees = check xlsx:parseSheet("employees.xlsx");
```

parameters.name: sheet
parameters.description: Sheet name or 0-based index (default: 0, the first sheet)

return.description: Parsed rows or an error

functions.name: writeSheet
functions.description:
Write rows to a sheet in an XLSX file, creating the file if it does not exist.

Only the named sheet is affected; other sheets, their tables, and formulas are preserved.
By default the write fails if the sheet already exists.

```ballerina
Employee[] employees = [{name: "John", age: 30}];
check xlsx:writeSheet(employees, "staff.xlsx", "Employees");
```

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Rows to write (records, maps, or string arrays)

parameters.name: writeHeaders
parameters.description: Write a header row from field names or map keys (default: true; ignored for `string[][]`)

parameters.name: startRowIndex
parameters.description:
0-based row where a fresh write starts (default: 0). Used by `FAIL_IF_EXISTS` and `REPLACE`;
ignored by `APPEND`, which writes below the existing data.

parameters.name: sheetWriteMode
parameters.description:
How to treat the sheet when it already exists (default: `FAIL_IF_EXISTS`). `REPLACE` drops
and recreates the sheet, discarding its tables and formatting.

return.description: An error if the write fails, or if the sheet exists under FAIL_IF_EXISTS

functions.name: parseTable
functions.description:
Parse an Excel table by name into records, maps, or a string grid.

Table names are unique across the workbook, so no sheet is needed. Headers and any totals
row are excluded.

```ballerina
Employee[] employees = check xlsx:parseTable("sales.xlsx", "EmployeeTable");
```

parameters.name: tableName
parameters.description: Name of the table to parse

return.description: Parsed rows or an error such as `TableNotFoundError`

functions.name: writeTable
functions.description:
Write rows to an existing Excel table, resizing its data range to fit.

By default the table's data is replaced; `tableWriteMode = APPEND` adds rows below it instead.

```ballerina
check xlsx:writeTable(employees, "sales.xlsx", "EmployeeTable");
```

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Rows to write (records, maps, or string arrays)

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to the XLSX file containing the table

parameters.name: tableName
parameters.description: Name of the table to write to

parameters.name: tableWriteMode
parameters.description: How to treat the table's existing data (default: `REPLACE`)

parameters.name: insertAt
parameters.description:
For `APPEND`, the 0-based data-row index to insert at; omitted, appends at the end.
Ignored by `REPLACE`.

return.description: A `TableNotFoundError`, a `TableOverlapError` if a resize collides, or another error

functions.name: fromFile
functions.description:
Open an XLSX workbook from a file path.

To create a new file, use `new` and then `saveAs(path)`.

return.description: The opened workbook, or an error if the path is missing or the file is invalid

functions.name: fromBytes
functions.description:
Open an XLSX workbook from an in-memory byte array.

The workbook has no associated file; use `saveAs(path)` to persist it.

parameters.name: sourceBytes
parameters.description: XLSX content as a byte array

return.description: The opened workbook, or an error if the bytes are invalid

annotations.name: Name
annotations.description: Annotation to specify the Excel column name for a record field.
